inventory.id_hash_encoding: sorted IDs joined with LF plus trailing LF, UTF-8

system.segmentation: whole clip, exactly one utterance; VAD is NOT executed
system.q_forwards: one Q-A, one Q-AV, one Q-V for a usable face clip; no-face reuses Q-A and HV is unavailable
system.H3_gate: frozen X06b H3, no-face -> HA, ambiguous multi-face -> reject at R90
system.HV_gate: face only, no-face unavailable, multi-face reject; report existing R90 threshold
system.HV_R80: unchanged deployment setting, not used for the requested R90 secondary comparison

metrics.pearson_available: Pearson on available media, including gated rejection and H3 no-face -> HA fallback
metrics.spearman_available: Pearson of average-tie ranks on same available media
metrics.acc2: all nonzero ground-truth labels as denominator; unavailable or score=0 is incorrect; otherwise compare signs (X01)
metrics.pearson_all_uniform: all 1034 test / 647 valid IDs; unavailable media probabilities uniform, score -3/7
metrics.op_r90_coverage: accepted by fixed per-system R90 threshold and modality/multi-face gates / all IDs
metrics.pearson_accepted: Pearson restricted to R90 accepted IDs
metrics.neutral_non_neutral_rate: available prediction with OP-N label != neutral / all ground-truth label=0 IDs
metrics.unavailable: missing file, missing audio, ffprobe/audio/native-frame decode failure -> all systems uniform/unavailable; no-face -> HV uniform/unavailable only
metrics.degenerate: null when correlation has <2 samples or zero variance; never substitute zero

bootstrap.sampling: draw N videos from N unique videos with replacement; retain every clip and multiplicity; then metric-specific filters
bootstrap.degenerate: omit undefined replicate for that metric and report valid count

gates.L2: all seven source assertions and all three suspected MER exclusions must pass

execution.labels: L2 and pre-metric-lock checks read identity columns only, verify the frozen meta SHA, exact split IDs and one physical line per record; both receipts must match. After complete.json and O_EXCL metric lock, parse only that split label rows; all other split rows are skipped before label parsing.
execution.metric_lock: O_EXCL before label read; no second attempt, overwrite, rerun or modification after metrics
execution.resume: only documented infrastructure failure, same code and config, skip every persisted completed clip
execution.budget: sum of complete GPU child wall times including loading and waiting; CPU preparation excluded
execution.storage_gate_scope: WSL execution host root /; all new media and outputs on /mnt/h

comparison.valid: same code and protocol, all same metrics
comparison.et_test: cite X06b R3 existing 7-class results, never rerun

revision.reason: X07_REVISION_1.md authorizes isolating split label access and moving identity and physical-line checks to L2 and before the one-shot metric lock. v1 stopped before GPU inference or any metrics; no test media were read.
revision.preservation: v1 protocol, execution directory, STOP and all records remain unchanged
revision.native_decode_failures: The seven v1 valid failures keep the frozen unavailable-media rule; no decoder or parameter change is permitted.
